title: 6/10 new CI test gate failed two deploys on a lockfile/TZ mismatch (uv --locked on a UTC runner), not on tests
tier_reason: two deploy runs failed closed before the SSH step (production untouched); the queued deploy was delayed by about ten minutes, with no delivery, entry, state or recoverability impact

contract.text: A push to the deploy branch whose fast test suite is green deploys; the test gate blocks a deploy only when the suite fails.
contract.source: .github/workflows/deploy.yml 'Test gate' step (1ac0b0c, audit T1: 'a red suite blocks the deploy')

mechanism.text: the test gate added the night before (1ac0b0c) ran `uv sync --locked` on a UTC GitHub runner; the date-only exclude-newer in uv.lock resolves in local time and uv.lock is generated on America/New_York machines, so the runner shifted it 04:00Z -> 00:00Z and --locked rejected the lockfile before pytest ran, failing the job before the deploy step

code.symbol: deploy job 'Install uv' + 'Test gate' steps (no TZ, unpinned setup-uv)

verified_recovered.how: the next deploy run (head 279d423, the TZ fix) concluded success

residual.text: CI's uv is pinned to the box's 0.11.6 and must be bumped alongside the box and uv.lock; a mismatch fails the gate closed again (production untouched, deploy delayed).

watchdog.trigger: a push to the deploy branch whose run fails before the SSH step (no pytest summary and no 'Pre-deploy SHA' line in the log) leaves the box's installed SHA behind the deploy-branch head for more than one run interval
watchdog.recovery_assertion: a later run on the same or a descendant head records a pytest summary, 'Deployed <sha>' and 'CANARY PASSED', and the box SHA equals the deploy-branch head

evidence.what: first deploy run after the gate (head cb7d00b), created 2026-06-10T14:26:24Z, concluded failure; retained log has no pytest summary, pre-deploy or deploy line
run on head 8c93799 (uv pinned), created 2026-06-10T14:31:04Z, also concluded failure with no pytest summary or deploy line: the pin alone did not fix it
`uv sync --locked` rejected uv.lock and the test gate failed before deploying (production untouched)
the date-only exclude-newer resolves in local time; a UTC runner shifted it and --locked rejected it (verified: uv lock --check passes under TZ=America/New_York, fails under TZ=UTC)
run on head 279d423, created 2026-06-10T14:35:51Z, concluded success (log expired)
retained log records pre-deploy SHA 83a5cad at 2026-07-02T15:28:10Z, the first retained log after 6/07; 8c93799 and 279d423 are ancestors of 83a5cad
the test gate (uv sync --locked --extra model + pytest -m 'not slow' before the SSH deploy, skip_tests bypass on workflow_dispatch) was added 2026-06-09 23:22 ET (audit T1)

X: docs/audit/2026-06-09-fable5-full-audit.md 'Act on these first' #7 (No CI runs the tests)
